items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The diff matches the reference solution. Names are clear (compile_json_path_final_key, HasKeyOrArrayIndex, final_key), there is a comment explaining why ints are not treated as array elements, and the formatting fits the existing code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: There is one overridable hook, compile_json_path is reused for the leading segments, and a small HasKeyOrArrayIndex subclass serves the internal callers. No logic is copied per backend and no dead code is left behind.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The change is small and adds no error handling that could fail. json.dumps quotes the key safely. The isnull/exact=None paths keep their array-index behaviour, and the hidden tests pass (F2P 2/2, P2P 78/78).

items.name: Array-index semantics kept for isnull / exact=None paths
items.name_zh: isnull / exact=None 路径保留数组下标语义
items.evidence: The change is in shared HasKeyLookup.as_sql, so SQLite, MySQL and Oracle all get it. KeyTransformIsNull.as_oracle/as_sqlite and KeyTransformExact.as_oracle now use HasKeyOrArrayIndex. Intermediate segments still go through compile_json_path.
